objective: Compute a gym membership quote. Start with base setup fee 100, then add monthly_fee * months. If loyalty=1 AND months>=12, subtract a 50 loyalty discount. Apply tax_pct% on the result. Return the value rounded to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module GymQuote
  (defun gym_quote ((months : Num) (monthly_fee : Num) (loyalty : Num) (tax_pct : Num)) : Num
    (def base : Num (+ 100 (* monthly_fee months)))
    (def discounted : Num (if (= loyalty 1)
                              (if (>= months 12) (- base 50) base)
                              base))
    (def taxed : Num (* discounted (+ 1 (/ tax_pct 100))))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* taxed 100) 0.5)) 100)))
  (test t1 (assert-near (gym_quote 1 50 0 0) 150.0 0.01))
  (test t2 (assert-near (gym_quote 12 50 1 0) 650.0 0.01))
  (test t3 (assert-near (gym_quote 12 50 1 10) 715.0 0.01))
  (test t4 (assert-near (gym_quote 6 75 0 8) 594.0 0.01))
  (test t5 (assert-near (gym_quote 24 40 1 5) 1060.5 0.01)))

objective: Compute an electric bill. Tiered usage rates: first 500 kWh at 0.10/kWh, anything over 500 at 0.15/kWh. Add a fixed service fee of 20. Apply tax_pct% on (usage_cost + service_fee). Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module PowerBill
  (defun power_bill ((kwh : Num) (tax_pct : Num)) : Num
    (def tier1 : Num (* (math.min kwh 500) 0.10))
    (def tier2 : Num (* (math.max 0 (- kwh 500)) 0.15))
    (def usage_cost : Num (+ tier1 tier2))
    (def service_fee : Num 20)
    (def subtotal : Num (+ usage_cost service_fee))
    (def total : Num (* subtotal (+ 1 (/ tax_pct 100))))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* total 100) 0.5)) 100)))
  (test t1 (assert-near (power_bill 0 0) 20.0 0.01))
  (test t2 (assert-near (power_bill 500 0) 70.0 0.01))
  (test t3 (assert-near (power_bill 1000 0) 145.0 0.01))
  (test t4 (assert-near (power_bill 1000 10) 159.5 0.01))
  (test t5 (assert-near (power_bill 200 6) 42.4 0.01)))

objective: Compute the annual cost of a streaming subscription. Base = monthly_fee * 12. If loyalty=1, subtract 2 months worth (2 * monthly_fee). Then apply state_tax_pct%. Round to 2 decimals.

objective: Compute a hotel stay cost. Start with base = nightly_rate * nights. If nights >= 7, apply 10% discount on the base. Then apply tax_pct% on the discounted base. Finally add a flat resort fee of 25 (not taxed). Round to 2 decimals.

(module HotelTotal

objective: Compute freight cost. Banded weight rates: first 50 lbs at 2/lb, next 150 lbs (50..200) at 1.5/lb, remainder over 200 at 1/lb. Add a flat handling fee of 25. Apply fuel_pct% on (weight_cost + handling). Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module FreightCharge
  (defun freight_charge ((weight_lbs : Num) (fuel_pct : Num)) : Num
    (def b1 : Num (* (math.min weight_lbs 50) 2))
    (def b2 : Num (* (math.max 0 (- (math.min weight_lbs 200) 50)) 1.5))
    (def b3 : Num (* (math.max 0 (- weight_lbs 200)) 1))
    (def weight_cost : Num (+ (+ b1 b2) b3))
    (def subtotal : Num (+ weight_cost 25))
    (def total : Num (* subtotal (+ 1 (/ fuel_pct 100))))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* total 100) 0.5)) 100)))

  (test t5 (assert-near (freight_charge 200 8) 378.0 0.05)))

objective: Compute concert ticket total. Subtotal = ticket_price * qty. Service fee = subtotal * fee_pct/100. If group=1 AND qty>=5, apply 8% group discount on subtotal (the fee is computed off the un-discounted subtotal). Final = (discounted_subtotal) + fee. Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module ConcertTicket
  (defun concert_ticket_total ((ticket_price : Num) (qty : Num) (fee_pct : Num) (group : Num)) : Num
    (def subtotal : Num (* ticket_price qty))
    (def fee : Num (* subtotal (/ fee_pct 100)))
    (def discount : Num (if (and (= group 1) (>= qty 5)) (* subtotal 0.08) 0.0))
    (def total : Num (+ (- subtotal discount) fee))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* total 100) 0.5)) 100)))

objective: Compute sales commission with three tiers. First 10000 of sales pays 5%, the next 40000 (sales between 10000 and 50000) pays 10%, anything above 50000 pays 15%. Sum and round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module CommissionPayout

    (def t1 : Num (* (math.min sales 10000) 0.05))
    (def t2 : Num (* (math.max 0 (- (math.min sales 50000) 10000)) 0.10))
    (def t3 : Num (* (math.max 0 (- sales 50000)) 0.15))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* (+ (+ t1 t2) t3) 100) 0.5)) 100)))

objective: Compute parking garage fee. If hours <= 0, fee is 0. The first hour (any portion 0 < hours <= 1) costs a flat 5. Each additional hour above 1 costs 3 (linear, not banded). Daily maximum cap is 20. Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module ParkingFee
  (defun parking_garage_fee ((hours : Num)) : Num
    (def fee : Num 0)
    (if (<= hours 0)
        (set fee 0)
        (if (<= hours 1)
            (set fee 5)
            (set fee (+ 5 (* (- hours 1) 3)))))
    (set fee (math.min fee 20))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* fee 100) 0.5)) 100)))
  (test t1 (assert-near (parking_garage_fee 0) 0 0.01))
  (test t2 (assert-near (parking_garage_fee 1) 5.0 0.01))
  (test t3 (assert-near (parking_garage_fee 3) 11.0 0.01))

objective: Apply a season-based discount. month_idx is 0..11 (January=0). Discount % by month index: 0->20, 1->20, 2->10, 3->0, 4->0, 5->5, 6->5, 7->5, 8->10, 9->15, 10->25, 11->25. Return base_price * (1 - discount_pct/100). Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module SeasonDiscount
  (defun discount_pct ((idx : Num)) : Num
    (if (= idx 0) 20
      (if (= idx 1) 20
        (if (= idx 2) 10
          (if (= idx 3) 0
            (if (= idx 4) 0
              (if (= idx 5) 5
                (if (= idx 6) 5
                  (if (= idx 7) 5
                    (if (= idx 8) 10
                      (if (= idx 9) 15
                        (if (= idx 10) 25 25))))))))))))
  (defun seasonal_discount ((month_idx : Num) (base_price : Num)) : Num
    (def pct : Num (discount_pct month_idx))
    (def raw : Num (* base_price (- 1 (/ pct 100))))
    (/ (math.floor (+ (* raw 100) 0.5)) 100))
  (test t1 (assert-near (seasonal_discount 0 100) 80.0 0.01))
  (test t2 (assert-near (seasonal_discount 3 100) 100.0 0.01))
  (test t3 (assert-near (seasonal_discount 6 100) 95.0 0.01))

objective: Compute compound savings growth: principal * (1 + (annual_pct/100) / n_per_year) ^ (n_per_year * years). Use math.pow for the exponentiation. Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module SavingsGrowth
  (defun savings_growth ((principal : Num) (annual_pct : Num) (n_per_year : Num) (years : Num)) : Num
    (def rate : Num (/ (/ annual_pct 100) n_per_year))
    (def base : Num (+ 1 rate))
    (def exponent : Num (* n_per_year years))
    (def amount : Num (* principal (math.pow base exponent)))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* amount 100) 0.5)) 100)))

objective: Compute the area of a triangle with sides a, b, c using Heron's formula. Let s = (a + b + c) / 2. Area = math.sqrt(s * (s-a) * (s-b) * (s-c)). Round to 2 decimals.

objective: Compute a tour package price. price = base + (people - 1) * per_extra. If people >= 5, apply a 10% group discount on the price. Round to 2 decimals.
solution:
(module TourPackage
  (defun tour_package_price ((people : Num) (base : Num) (per_extra : Num)) : Num
    (def raw : Num (+ base (* (- people 1) per_extra)))
    (def adjusted : Num (if (>= people 5) (* raw 0.9) raw))
    (return (/ (math.floor (+ (* adjusted 100) 0.5)) 100)))
  (test t1 (assert-near (tour_package_price 1 500 200) 500.0 0.01))
  (test t2 (assert-near (tour_package_price 2 500 200) 700.0 0.01))
  (test t3 (assert-near (tour_package_price 4 500 200) 1100.0 0.01))
  (test t4 (assert-near (tour_package_price 5 500 200) 1170.0 0.01))
  (test t5 (assert-near (tour_package_price 10 500 200) 2070.0 0.01)))

objective: Classify a temperature in celsius. < 0 -> "Freezing". < 10 -> "Cold". < 20 -> "Mild". < 30 -> "Warm". >= 30 -> "Hot".
solution:
(module TempLabel
  (defun temperature_label ((celsius : Num)) : Str
    (if (< celsius 0) "Freezing"
      (if (< celsius 10) "Cold"
        (if (< celsius 20) "Mild"
          (if (< celsius 30) "Warm" "Hot")))))
  (test t1 (assert-eq (temperature_label -5) "Freezing"))
  (test t2 (assert-eq (temperature_label 5) "Cold"))
  (test t3 (assert-eq (temperature_label 15) "Mild"))
  (test t4 (assert-eq (temperature_label 25) "Warm"))
  (test t5 (assert-eq (temperature_label 35) "Hot")))

objective: Classify precipitation rate. mm_per_hr <= 0 -> "None". < 2.5 -> "Drizzle". < 10 -> "Steady". >= 10 -> "Heavy".
solution:
(module Precipitation
  (defun precipitation_intensity ((mm_per_hr : Num)) : Str
    (if (<= mm_per_hr 0) "None"
      (if (< mm_per_hr 2.5) "Drizzle"
        (if (< mm_per_hr 10) "Steady" "Heavy"))))

  (test t5 (assert-eq (precipitation_intensity 15) "Heavy")))
